title: Create PRD-compliant directory structure
description:
Restructure the project to match the mandatory directory layout from PRD Section 3.

Current flat structure needs to be reorganized into:
- agent/ (controller, planner, executor, verifier, reflector)
- perception/ (browser, capture, video, diff)
- sandbox/ (docker, runner, cleanup)
- memory/ (thoughtStore, confidence, schema)
- tools/ (tests, git, filesystem)
- types/ (index.ts)
- config/ (policies.ts)

Steps:
1. Create all directories
2. Move existing files to appropriate locations
3. Update all import paths
4. Verify build succeeds

title: Implement ThoughtStore schema with SQLite
description:
Implement persistent storage for ThoughtSignatures using better-sqlite3.

Schema tables:
- thoughts: id, run_id, thinking_level, hypothesis, decision, outcome, confidence, evidence_refs, created_at, summary
- verification_artifacts: id, run_id, type, data, summary, created_at
- confidence_events: id, thought_id, signal, weight, created_at
- runs: id, repo_owner, repo_name, branch, status, current_phase, current_confidence, created_at

Steps:
1. Install better-sqlite3
2. Create schema.ts with table definitions
3. Create migrations
4. Implement CRUD operations
5. Add indexes for performance

title: Implement ThoughtStore service
description:
Build the ThoughtStore service that manages all thought persistence.

Features:
- createThought(thought: Omit<ThoughtSignature, 'id' | 'createdAt'>)
- getThoughts(runId: string): ThoughtSignature[]
- getThoughtsByLevel(runId: string, level: ThinkingLevel)
- updateThoughtOutcome(id: string, outcome: string)
- linkEvidence(thoughtId: string, artifactId: string)
- getThoughtChain(runId: string) - returns ordered thought sequence

Constraints:
- No free-text reasoning allowed (PRD Section 5)
- All thoughts must have hypothesis and decision

title: Implement Confidence Calculator
description:
Build deterministic confidence computation system per PRD Section 6.

Base confidence = 0.2

Signal weights:
- test_pass: +0.25
- visual_regression_removed: +0.20
- dom_diff_reduced: +0.15
- console_errors_removed: +0.20
- new_error: -0.35
- visual_regression: -0.30
- test_fail: -0.40

Methods:
- computeConfidence(events: ConfidenceEvent[]): number
- addSignal(thoughtId: string, signal: SignalType)
- getConfidenceHistory(runId: string)
- isDeliveryReady(runId: string): boolean (>= 0.85)

Constraints:
- Confidence must be COMPUTED not generated
- Clamp between 0.0 and 1.0

title: Create Gemini 3 prompt templates
description:
Design structured prompts for all AI reasoning tasks.

Prompt templates needed:
- DIAGNOSIS_PROMPT: Analyze code for defects
- PLANNING_PROMPT: Generate fix strategy
- CODE_FIX_PROMPT: Generate corrected code
- REFLECTION_PROMPT: Evaluate iteration success
- VISUAL_ANALYSIS_PROMPT: Interpret screenshot diffs
- ROOT_CAUSE_PROMPT: Determine root cause from artifacts

Constraints per PRD Section 8:
- Gemini must NEVER declare success
- Gemini must NEVER skip verification
- Gemini must NEVER modify files directly
- All outputs must be structured JSON

title: Implement core agent loop
description:
Build the OBSERVE→DIAGNOSE→PLAN→EXECUTE→VERIFY→REFLECT loop.

Loop phases per PRD Section 4:
1. OBSERVE: Capture screenshots, DOM, logs
2. DIAGNOSE: AI analysis of state
3. PLAN: Generate fix strategy
4. EXECUTE: Apply code changes
5. VERIFY: Run tests, compare visuals
6. REFLECT: Compute confidence, decide next action

Constraints:
- Loop until confidence >= 0.85 or max iterations
- Every action produces artifact
- Every decision references artifacts
- No skipping phases

title: Implement retry and rollback logic
description:
Build failure handling per PRD Section 10.

On verification failure:
1. Roll back code changes
2. Record failure ThoughtSignature
3. Reduce confidence
4. Generate revised hypothesis
5. Retry

Methods:
- rollbackChanges(runId: string): Promise<void>
- recordFailure(thought: ThoughtSignature, reason: string)
- generateRevisedHypothesis(failedHypothesis: string): Promise<string>
- shouldRetry(runId: string): boolean
- getRetryCount(runId: string): number

Constraints:
- Max retries configurable (default 3)
- Abort cleanly if max exceeded

title: Implement stop conditions
description:
Build logic for determining when to stop the loop.

Stop conditions:
- Confidence >= 0.85 (success, proceed to PR)
- Max iterations reached (stop, no PR)
- Confidence < 0.3 after 2 iterations (stop, failing)
- User requested stop
- Unrecoverable error

Methods:
- evaluateStopCondition(runId: string): StopCondition | null
- handleStopCondition(condition: StopCondition): Promise<void>
- getStopReason(runId: string): string
